title: Astro + Django：从个人博客到可维护的内容平台
title_en: A maintainable content platform with Astro and Django
description: 静态前端、实时内容 API、独立站点路由与可靠邮件队列的工程实践。
description_en: Static hosting, live content APIs, isolated routes and a durable email outbox.
body:
这个项目把静态页面的低成本部署与动态内容管理结合起来。Astro 前端部署在 GitHub Pages，文章、系列、评论和讨论由 PythonAnywhere 上的 Django 提供。

## 核心设计

- **内容只有一个来源**：前端读取 Django API，避免发布文章后还需要同步修改静态文件。
- **展示与管理分离**：公开博客、独立 Articles 页面与 Django 管理后台各有入口；InfoTech 使用独立 URL 前缀和数据库。
- **邮件进入持久化队列**：后台任务领取数据库通知，使用租约防止重复领取，失败后退避重试；发送不阻塞页面请求。

## 实现与验证

管理员可以维护中英文文章、系列和讨论。前端统一切换语言，Markdown 经过渲染后展示。最近一次本地验证通过 57 项 Django 测试；线上博客 API、管理员入口和 InfoTech 均返回正常响应。

## 取舍

GitHub Pages 只托管前端，内容请求依赖后端可用性。两站共享 Django 进程，数据库隔离并不等于计算资源隔离。Articles 的隐藏入口仍是公开页面；当前订阅采用邮箱直接登录，不应当作为高安全等级的账号系统。

[源码](https://github.com/Hajiwo/Hajiwo.github.io) · [网站](https://hajiwo.github.io/)
body_en:
The platform combines inexpensive static hosting with dynamic content management. Astro runs on GitHub Pages; Django on PythonAnywhere provides articles, series, comments and discussions.

## Design

- Django is the content source of truth; the frontend reads live APIs.
- Public blogs, the standalone Articles section and administration have separate routes. InfoTech also has a routed database.
- Email uses a durable database outbox. A background worker claims notifications with leases and retries failures with backoff, outside page requests.

## Validation

The latest local Django suite passed 57 tests. Live checks confirmed the blog API, administration entry and InfoTech responses. Bilingual content and Markdown are managed through the backend.

## Tradeoffs

Static hosting still depends on API availability. The sites share a process and hosting resources. The unlinked Articles section remains publicly accessible. Email-only subscriber sign-in is a convenience identity mechanism, not a strong authentication system.

[Source](https://github.com/Hajiwo/Hajiwo.github.io) · [Website](https://hajiwo.github.io/)

title: Smart Garage：可在无硬件环境验证的事件驱动后端
title_en: Smart Garage: an event-driven backend with a software simulator
description: 用 MQTT 事件串联状态更新、规划和执行器，并用模拟链路验证后端行为。
description_en: A sensor-to-actuator pipeline with state validation, planning and software integration tests.
body:
Smart Garage 是一个 IoT 课程项目。本文聚焦仓库中的 Python 后端：传感器事件进入系统后，更新车库状态，再生成风扇、灯光和闸门控制指令。

## 数据流

`传感器事件 → ContextManager → Planner → Executor → actuator command`

ContextManager 按 topic 检查序列号，拒绝重复或过期消息，并使用锁保护共享状态。规划层生成 PDDL 问题；没有 Fast Downward 时，可以使用确定性规则后端。执行层把规划结果映射为 MQTT topic 与消息。

## 为什么加入模拟器

软件模式提供本地 broker 和模拟传感器，让后端逻辑不依赖 Raspberry Pi。Dashboard 展示状态、事件与执行器指令，便于追踪“输入为什么导致这个动作”。模拟 broker 使用项目自己的协议，不能代替真实 MQTT 硬件验证。

## 验证与整理

本次运行通过 31 项软件测试，覆盖状态管理、规划、执行、Dashboard 和模拟链路。仓库补充轻量测试依赖与 CI，运行配置改用被忽略的本地 `.env`，由 `.env.example` 提供模板。

硬件、摄像头 OCR 和真实设备可靠性需要单独验证；测试通过不代表这些集成已经验证。

[源码](https://github.com/Hajiwo/Internet-of-Things-Project-) · [状态更新](https://github.com/Hajiwo/Internet-of-Things-Project-/blob/main/context/manager.py)
body_en:
Smart Garage is an IoT course project. This report focuses on its Python backend: sensor events update garage state, then produce commands for lights, fans and gates.

## Pipeline

`sensor event → ContextManager → Planner → Executor → actuator command`

Context updates validate per-topic sequence numbers and reject stale or duplicate messages. Locks protect shared state. The planner generates PDDL problems and can use a deterministic fallback when Fast Downward is unavailable. The executor maps actions to actuator messages.

## Testability

A local broker and sensor simulator exercise backend behavior without a Raspberry Pi. The dashboard exposes state, recent events and commands. The simulated broker's protocol does not replace real MQTT integration testing.

## Validation

All 31 software tests passed in this review. Lightweight test dependencies and CI were added; local configuration uses an ignored .env and a committed template.

Physical hardware, camera OCR and real-device reliability remain separate validation tasks.

[Source](https://github.com/Hajiwo/Internet-of-Things-Project-) · [State management](https://github.com/Hajiwo/Internet-of-Things-Project-/blob/main/context/manager.py)

title: SeuLex：从正则规则到可运行的词法分析器
title_en: SeuLex: from regular expressions to a generated lexer
description: C++ 编译原理课程项目：正则表达式、NFA、DFA 与扫描器代码生成。
description_en: A C++ compiler-design project covering automata construction and scanner generation.
body:
SeuLex 是一个 C++ 编译原理课程项目。输入是 Lex 风格的 C-minus 词法规则，输出是可以编译运行的 C++ 扫描器。

## 实现链路

`规则解析 → 正则标准化与后缀化 → NFA → DFA → DFA 最小化 → 扫描器代码`

规则处理、自动机构建和代码输出分开实现。扫描器使用自动机转移表识别 token，并调用规则对应的动作。这样的拆分让每个阶段的中间结果可以单独检查。

## 本次验证

在 macOS 使用 C++17 编译生成器，成功生成扫描器，再编译运行它分析仓库提供的 C-minus 样例。补充了 `make smoke` 和 CI；冒烟测试区分关键字 `int` 与标识符 `integer`，检查实际 token 输出。

## 项目边界

这是教育用途的 ASCII 词法工具，不是完整编译器。路径依赖当前工作目录；Unicode、非法输入和超长 token 的缓冲区边界还没有完整测试。博客展示自动机与代码生成实现，不宣称生产级解析器。

[源码](https://github.com/Hajiwo/SeuLex-a-cminus_lexcical_analyser) · [自动机构建](https://github.com/Hajiwo/SeuLex-a-cminus_lexcical_analyser/blob/main/Method_Automata.cpp)
body_en:
SeuLex is a C++ compiler-design course project. It reads Lex-style C-minus rules and emits a compilable C++ scanner.

## Pipeline

`rule parsing → regex normalization/postfix → NFA → DFA → minimization → scanner source`

Rule processing, automata construction and source emission are separate stages. The scanner follows transition tables and executes rule actions, making intermediate results inspectable.

## Validation

The generator and generated scanner were compiled with C++17 on macOS and run on the included C-minus sample. A Makefile and CI now reproduce this workflow. The smoke test checks that int is recognized as a keyword while integer remains an identifier.

## Scope

This is an educational ASCII lexer, not a full compiler. Paths depend on the working directory. Unicode, malformed input and long-token buffer boundaries still need broader tests.

[Source](https://github.com/Hajiwo/SeuLex-a-cminus_lexcical_analyser) · [Automata](https://github.com/Hajiwo/SeuLex-a-cminus_lexcical_analyser/blob/main/Method_Automata.cpp)

title: Convolution Lab：把数值计算拆成可检查的交互步骤
title_en: Convolution Lab: making numerical operations inspectable
description: React + TypeScript 可视化离散卷积、连续卷积和图像滤波，模型独立于 UI。
description_en: React and TypeScript experiments with pure numerical models and production render tests.
body:
卷积实验室把抽象的计算拆为翻转、平移、逐项相乘和求和。用户可以修改离散序列，观察连续函数的重叠积分，也可以逐个计算图像滤波的输出像素。

## 工程设计

纯 TypeScript 模型负责数值计算；React 负责交互与呈现。SVG 绘制信号和曲线，HTML 矩阵显示图像像素，动画只负责步骤之间的过渡。

三个实验共享“当前计算步骤”的交互思路。离散卷积展示每个乘积项；连续卷积使用有限区间的黎曼和；图像实验用对称的 box/Gaussian 核，将 7×7 输入变为 5×5 有效窗口输出。

## 验证

4 项模型测试与 1 项生产渲染测试通过，lint 与构建通过。公开版本去除了原托管账号元数据和未使用的认证脚手架，并加入 CI。

## 取舍

数值积分是近似结果，图像核是小型教学样例。这个项目展示的是计算模型、交互状态和可验证呈现的设计，而非通用科学计算库。

[源码](https://github.com/Hajiwo/convolution-lab) · [数值模型](https://github.com/Hajiwo/convolution-lab/blob/main/visualizations/mathematics/convolution/model.ts)
body_en:
Convolution Lab exposes flip, shift, multiply and sum steps. Users edit discrete sequences, inspect continuous overlap integrals and compute image-filter output pixels individually.

## Architecture

A pure TypeScript model handles calculations; React handles interaction and presentation. SVG renders signals and curves, HTML matrices render image pixels, and animation connects steps.

Discrete experiments expose individual products. Continuous experiments use finite-domain Riemann sums. Symmetric box/Gaussian kernels produce a 5×5 valid-window result from a 7×7 image.

## Validation

Four model tests and one production-render test passed, alongside lint and build. The public export removes hosting-account metadata and unused authentication scaffolding and includes CI.

## Tradeoffs

Integration is approximate and image inputs are small teaching examples. The project demonstrates numerical-model separation and inspectable interaction, rather than a general scientific-computing library.

[Source](https://github.com/Hajiwo/convolution-lab) · [Model](https://github.com/Hajiwo/convolution-lab/blob/main/visualizations/mathematics/convolution/model.ts)

title: Recall：可测试的间隔复习调度与本地状态迁移
title_en: Recall: deterministic review scheduling and local state migration
description: 把调度算法、固定复习队列和浏览器持久化分离，构建可解释的学习工具。
description_en: Deterministic scheduling, fixed review batches and versioned browser persistence.
body:
Recall 是一个 React 词汇复习工具，解决“下一步复习什么、什么时候再出现”的问题。复习、查词、单词笔记与学习统计都在浏览器中完成。

## 调度与状态

调度器使用七档时间间隔的明确转移表，根据“记住／没记住”调整下次出现时间。计算函数接收时间参数，所以测试可以检查确切的到期时间，不依赖真实等待。

到期单词按时间排序，每组最多 30 个；开始后当前组保持固定，避免新到期单词突然改变用户正在处理的队列。版本迁移保留旧记录，并补充活动统计与笔记字段。

## 验证与修正

11 项测试覆盖间隔转移、到期分组、状态迁移、搜索、笔记和统计，生产构建通过。修正了词表资源的根路径引用，使其遵守 Vite 的 base 路径。公开仓库只提供小型示例词表，不包含个人原始词库。

## 取舍

学习进度保存在 localStorage，没有云同步。词典调用依赖外部服务。调度表是明确的产品规则，不是训练得到的记忆模型；默认初始化部分词汇为已学习也是可调整的假设。

[源码](https://github.com/Hajiwo/gre-recall) · [调度逻辑](https://github.com/Hajiwo/gre-recall/blob/main/src/lib/core.js)
body_en:
Recall is a React vocabulary tool for deciding what to review next and when a word should reappear. Review, lookup, notes and activity summaries run in the browser.

## Scheduling

A seven-stage transition table adjusts intervals after pass/fail feedback. Pure functions accept timestamps, so due times can be tested without waiting.

Due words are sorted and grouped into fixed batches of up to 30. New arrivals do not mutate the batch in progress. State migrations preserve prior records while adding activity and note fields.

## Validation and correction

Eleven tests cover scheduling, grouping, migration, search, notes and analytics; the production build passed. Word loading now respects Vite's base path. The public repository contains only an illustrative word list.

## Tradeoffs

localStorage provides persistence without cloud synchronization. Dictionary lookup depends on an external service. Scheduling is an explicit rule table, not a learned memory model; initial learned-word defaults are a product assumption.

[Source](https://github.com/Hajiwo/gre-recall) · [Scheduler](https://github.com/Hajiwo/gre-recall/blob/main/src/lib/core.js)

title: macOS Folder Launcher：键盘驱动的原生桌面工具
title_en: macOS Folder Launcher: a keyboard-driven native utility
description: 用 Objective-C、AppKit 和 Carbon 实现文件夹指令搜索、全局快捷键与 CSV 笔记。
description_en: A native Objective-C menu-bar utility with ranked folder search and CSV note capture.
body:
这个轻量 macOS 工具将常用文件夹映射为短指令。通过菜单栏或全局快捷键打开输入窗口，搜索并在 Finder 中打开目标；另一个窗口用于快速记录单词与释义。

## 实现选择

使用 Objective-C、Cocoa/AppKit 与 Carbon，不引入第三方运行时。搜索按完整指令、前缀、子串、文件夹名和路径分层排序；窗口支持键盘选择与回车确认。

文件夹配置保存在 Application Support 下的 JSON 文件；笔记追加到 UTF-8 CSV，并处理引号与逗号转义，预览最近保存的记录。公开源码不包含个人文件夹路径或实际笔记。

## 验证

本机完成原生编译和 ad-hoc 签名。自测验证指令校验、自动补全排序和 CSV 编解码；仓库配置了 macOS CI。整理 README 时明确了 Objective-C 技术栈与构建步骤。

## 取舍

应用只支持 macOS，ad-hoc 签名不等于公证分发。默认全局快捷键可能与其他应用冲突，文件夹快捷键可以调整；当前自动测试不覆盖窗口和快捷键的真实交互。

[源码](https://github.com/Hajiwo/macos-folder-launcher) · [原生实现](https://github.com/Hajiwo/macos-folder-launcher/blob/main/src/main.m)
body_en:
This lightweight macOS utility maps frequent folders to short commands. A menu-bar or global shortcut opens a search window and launches the selected folder in Finder. A second window captures vocabulary notes.

## Implementation

Objective-C, Cocoa/AppKit and Carbon provide native behavior without third-party runtime dependencies. Search ranks exact commands, prefixes, substrings, folder names and paths; keyboard navigation completes the workflow.

Commands persist as JSON in Application Support. Notes append to UTF-8 CSV with quote/comma escaping and a recent-entry preview. Personal paths and actual notes are excluded from the source repository.

## Validation

Native compilation and ad-hoc signing succeeded. Self-tests cover validation, autocomplete and CSV parsing/formatting; macOS CI is configured.

## Tradeoffs

The app is macOS-only. Ad-hoc signing is not notarized distribution. Default global shortcuts may conflict with other applications, and UI/hotkey behavior is outside current automated tests.

[Source](https://github.com/Hajiwo/macos-folder-launcher) · [Implementation](https://github.com/Hajiwo/macos-folder-launcher/blob/main/src/main.m)
